title: Pricing
description: Explore transparent pricing for growing marketing teams, with plans from $29 to custom enterprise packages.

blocks.heading: Pricing plans from $29/month to enterprise scale
blocks.description: Start with Starter at $29/month, move to Growth at $99/month for broader collaboration, or choose Enterprise pricing for advanced governance, support, and data volume needs.

blocks.heading: Starter at $29 and Growth at $99 cover everyday reporting needs
blocks.description: Use Starter for lightweight reporting with core connectors and automated refreshes, or choose Growth at $99/month for more dashboards, users, and faster team-wide collaboration.

image.alt: Team reviewing pricing plans and reporting package options

blocks.heading: Enterprise pricing is tailored for larger data operations
blocks.description: When your business needs higher source limits, advanced permissions, premium onboarding, or dedicated support, Enterprise plans are scoped around your reporting requirements and rollout goals.

image.alt: Business team discussing enterprise pricing and support options

blocks.heading: Choose the right price point for your team
blocks.description: Start at $29/month, upgrade to $99/month as collaboration expands, or contact us for a custom Enterprise quote built around your team size and reporting complexity.
